name: Welcome to Provider Selection
summary: The anonymous user chooses external-provider authentication from Welcome and the client opens the canonical provider-selection surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.welcome is visible

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.provider is visible

sourceReferences.note: External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
